growth_explanation: Eligible set grew 1,519 (6/16) -> 28,928 (6/22), a 19x increase not explained by corpus growth alone (papers 49k -> 97k, 2x). The delta is fresh UPC + enrichment-batch crawl output: new papers inserted as identity_status='unverified', canonical_source='prof_page_only', professor_paper_link.link_status='candidate'. These are freshly collected, not-yet-enriched. Implication: (a) W0b's LLM gate must run on 28,928 rows = heavy LLM cost -> batch + rate-limit + monitor; (b) many eligible rows are in-flight (still being enriched by candidate-generation/closure) -> the dry-run must snapshot and the apply should target stable subsets; (c) the 6/16 '92% garbage title' finding may or may not hold for the fresh batch -> only the dry-run (Slice B) reveals the true plausible/garbage split.

title_pollution_proxy_lower_bound.note: SQL regex proxy is a LOWER BOUND. The real is_plausible_paper_title guard (~40 regexes in paper/title_quality.py) is stricter; the true reject rate is knowable only by running the W0b dry-run (Slice B / task 6.1).

candidate_link_only_papers.note: prof_page_only, only candidate (never verified) links. Exactly the wrong-attribution population W0b targets.

out_of_w0b_scope.note: crossref/manual/dblp/s2 unverified rows are out of W0b scope -> Phase 6 D7 (prof-link verification) or identifier resolution. The ~12,082 prof_page_only unverified WITH a verified link are correctly excluded from the eligible set.

prior_baseline_2026_06_16.scan_filter: canonical_source='prof_page_only' AND identity_status NOT IN ('merged') AND NOT EXISTS verified professor_paper_link
prior_baseline_2026_06_16.interpretation: 92% of eligible rows were parser-garbage titles (root cause C2/C3), not wrong-attribution. Applying Gap B then would have mislabeled unverifiable-due-to-bad-title rows as rejected. This drove the plausible-title guard refinement (tasks 2.4/2.5/5.6).
prior_baseline_2026_06_16.note: Filter semantics differ slightly from the 6/22 scan (6/16 excluded identity_status='merged' but included confirmed/rejected; 6/22 restricts to unverified). The 19x growth is dominated by data change (fresh crawls), not the filter.
